doc.digest: Modulate Ableton Live and Max for Live Parameters
doc.description: The live.modulate~ object enables you to modulate the value of Live parameters in realtime using signal objects. To understand more about Live's parameters, look up the DeviceParameter Object Class in the Live Object Model.

methods.name: int
methods.digest: Send a value to the selected Live Parameter

methods.digest: Send a decimal value to the selected Live Parameter

methods.name: id
methods.digest: Set the Live object using it's id nn

methods.name: signal
methods.digest: Send signal values to the selected Live Parameter
